overview: White fianchettoes on g2 while Black sets up a Slav shape with ...d5 and ...c6. The game usually transposes to a Réti, Catalan-type or English structure after Nf3, O-O and c4, or White plays d4 for a Catalan. Play is slow and positional.

white_ideas.idea: Nf3, O-O, d3 or d4, c4, aiming at the long diagonal and Catalan-like pressure.
Play for e4 with a King's Indian Attack set-up.

black_ideas.idea: Slav structure: ...Nf6, ...Bf5 or ...Bg4 and ...e6, solid development.
Counter with ...e5 or ...Qb6 depending on White's set-up.

typical_structures.structure: Catalan or Réti set-ups with d5/c6 pawns against White's flank bishop.

soundness.notes: Fully sound; Black's set-up is solid.

structure.notes: Tension in the centre unresolved; flank opening transposition.

approach.notes: g3/Bg2 plus Nf3, d3 or c4 is a set-up White can use against anything.

level.notes: Little theory, strategic plans are clear enough.

character.reason: Quiet manoeuvring where neither side can lose quickly.

structure.reason: Flank opening with the centre undecided.

approach.reason: g3/Bg2 set-up usable against most defences.

level.reason: Plans are simple but there is no standard guide for the transpositions.

plans.reason: Bishop on g2 on the long diagonal.
